verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a developer API, so the axis applies. The pack documents no sandbox, test-mode keys, or isolated non-production environment for Brave Search API. The browser playground (docs-65) is an interactive way to call the real endpoints, not an isolated sandbox. The monthly free-call allowance is a pricing feature, not environment isolation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
